evals.prompt: Inject missing AEO elements. Target query: 'what is AEO for B2B SaaS'. AEO Report says: Check 1 FAIL (no definition in first 300 words, insertion point: after paragraph 1), Check 4 FAIL (no FAQ, insert before conclusion), all other checks PASS. Draft opening: 'Answer engine optimization is becoming increasingly important for B2B SaaS companies. In this guide we'll explain why and how to get started.'
evals.expected_output: Should inject exactly 2 elements. For Check 1: insert a definition block after paragraph 1 using the structure 'AEO is [definition]. It differs from SEO in that [distinction].' Definition must use natural language from the target query. For Check 4: generate a FAQ block with 7 Q&A pairs relevant to AEO for B2B SaaS. FAQ questions should sound like real buyer queries. All answers should start with direct answers. Should output INJECTIONS APPLIED: 2. Should mark each injection in the draft with an AEO INJECTION comment.
assertions: Injects exactly 2 elements (definition + FAQ)
Does not inject elements that were marked PASS
Definition block uses target query language (AEO, B2B SaaS)
Definition has the required two-sentence structure
FAQ has 7+ Q&A pairs
FAQ questions are in natural buyer language
FAQ answers start with direct answers (not hedges)
Injection comments mark each insertion
Word count before and after noted

evals.prompt: Inject. Target query: 'how to track AI search visibility for SaaS'. AEO Report: Check 2 FAIL (headings are generic: 'Introduction', 'The Process', 'Why It Matters', 'Conclusion'), Check 3 FAIL (no numbered process, insertion point: after 'The Process' section), all other checks PASS.
evals.expected_output: Should rewrite all 4 failing headings to query-format headings. 'Introduction' should be removed or replaced. 'The Process' → something like 'How to Track AI Search Visibility in 4 Steps'. 'Why It Matters' → 'Why B2B SaaS Companies Need AI Visibility Tracking'. 'Conclusion' → 'Next Steps for AI Search Monitoring'. For Check 3: acknowledge that the numbered process must be extracted from draft content, and since only headings were provided, should flag MANUAL REQUIRED for the numbered process section and provide the template.
assertions: Rewrites all 4 failing headings to query-format headings
No rewritten heading starts with 'Introduction' or remains generic
At least one heading variation (not all 'How to')
Each rewritten heading is 5-12 words
Flags numbered process as MANUAL REQUIRED since draft content not provided
Provides numbered process template
Does not invent process steps from thin air

evals.prompt: Run aeo-injector on this draft. No AEO report provided.
evals.expected_output: Should ask for the AEO_REPORT before proceeding. Should not run aeo-checker internally as a workaround. Should explain that aeo-checker must be run first to identify which elements are missing and where insertion points are. Should not attempt to 'guess' what might be missing.
assertions: Asks for AEO_REPORT before proceeding
Does not run aeo-checker internally
Does not attempt to guess missing elements
Explains why the AEO_REPORT is required
Directs user to run aeo-checker first

evals.prompt: Inject AEO elements. AEO Report says: ALL CHECKS PASSED. Target query: 'AEO vs SEO for B2B SaaS'.
evals.expected_output: Should output the original draft unchanged with a note that all checks passed. Should not inject anything. Should confirm the draft is ready for voice-validator.
assertions: Returns original draft unchanged
States 'all checks passed, no injection needed'
Does not invent elements to inject
Confirms draft ready for next step (voice-validator)

evals.prompt: Inject FAQ block. AEO Report: Check 4 FAIL. Target query: 'citation rate AEO metric for SaaS'. The article is about how to use citation rate as the primary metric for tracking AEO performance.
evals.expected_output: Should generate 7-10 FAQ Q&A pairs specifically about citation rate as an AEO metric. Questions should sound like real buyers: 'What is a good citation rate for a B2B SaaS company?', 'How often should I check my citation rate?', 'Can I improve citation rate without a domain authority increase?', etc. Answers should be 2-4 sentences each and self-contained. No answers should start with 'It depends' or hedge without a direct answer.
assertions: Generates 7-10 FAQ pairs
Questions are in natural buyer language
Questions are specific to citation rate (not generic AEO questions)
All answers start with a direct response
No answer starts with 'It depends', 'Great question', or similar hedges
Each answer is self-contained (makes sense without reading the article)
Answers are 2-4 sentences each
